name: OpenAudioBench
intro: OpenAudioBench 是 Baichuan-Audio 论文发布的公开音频理解基准，包含自建 Reasoning QA 202题、Spoken Llama Questions 300题、随机抽样的 Web Questions 1,000题与 TriviaQA 1,000题，以及筛选 helpful-base 和 vicuna 子集并移除数学与代码问题后的 AlpacaEval 199题，共2,701题。论文分别在语音转文本与非级联语音转语音设置下评测，后者合并交错输出中的文本后评分。
build_method: 自建音频推理题, 公开问答子集随机抽样与筛选, 作者TTS语音合成, 五组件公开发布
task_type: 开放式问答, 逻辑推理, 常识问答
eval_feature: 五个音频组件, 语音转文本与非级联语音转语音, GPT-4o参考答案判断或开放式质量评分, 固定评测工具与论文量纲存在记录差异
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Logical Reasoning, Commonsense QA
build_method_en: Self-constructed Audio Reasoning, Random Sampling and Filtering of Public QA Subsets, Author TTS Speech Synthesis, Five-component Public Release
eval_feature_en: Five Audio Components, Speech-to-text and Non-cascaded Speech-to-speech, GPT-4o Reference-based Correctness or Open-ended Quality Scoring, Documented Paper-to-harness Scale Drift
intro_en: OpenAudioBench is the public audio-understanding benchmark released with Baichuan-Audio. It contains 202 self-constructed Reasoning QA items, 300 Spoken Llama Questions, random samples of 1,000 Web Questions and 1,000 TriviaQA items, and 199 AlpacaEval items selected from helpful-base and vicuna after removing math and code questions, for 2,701 items total. The paper evaluates speech-to-text and non-cascaded speech-to-speech settings, merging interleaved output text before scoring the latter.

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-22; source_kind=primary_paper_and_fixed_official_git_and_huggingface_release. Paper: arXiv:2502.17239v1, especially Section 4.3 and Table 8; fixed PDF URL https://arxiv.org/pdf/2502.17239v1 and SHA-256 6afe8eff5e7e08603b1cd0759ff69d237568f125f7621687d88707f22353eb85. The paper says OpenAudioBench has five components: self-constructed Reasoning QA, Spoken Llama Questions, Web Questions, TriviaQA, and AlpacaEval. It selects helpful-base and vicuna from AlpacaEval, removes math and code questions, and retains 199. It randomly samples 1,000 questions from each full Web Questions and TriviaQA dataset because full evaluation is impractical. The instructions for Web Questions, TriviaQA, and AlpacaEval are synthesized with the authors' TTS model. The official release README supplies component counts of 202, 300, 1,000, 1,000, and 199, totaling 2,701. Paper evaluation uses GPT-4o with reference answers for Reasoning QA, Llama Questions, Web Questions, and TriviaQA; it calculates correctness percentages for the latter three and describes Reasoning QA as a reference-based score followed by accuracy. AlpacaEval receives a GPT-4o-based score. Two settings are reported: non-cascaded speech-to-speech, whose interleaved output text is merged for evaluation, and speech-to-text, whose direct text output is evaluated. Table 8 reports the five components separately and does not define a single overall aggregation formula. Fixed official project Git: https://github.com/baichuan-inc/Baichuan-Audio/tree/805d456433dbf3e0edb2bdd302f733a4bd38ea84, commit date 2025-02-28; README SHA-256 de005a55c115f56527c8fde12d3bf4df953092944781deba2a2a1856a63e2f92 and LICENSE SHA-256 d2df8b34314a57f1cacce407e51ffbb7c43648d207990141910148eafc5441cb. Its README names OpenAudioBench, the same five components, and 2,701 data points, and links the official dataset. Fixed official dataset and harness: https://huggingface.co/datasets/baichuan-inc/OpenAudioBench/tree/98f8fa0d5fa7e530ec8e6f097b55f10b003d111b; the revision is public and ungated. HF README SHA-256 is 2b930800a6abef894f2e7a5b3edfed289be78483de4f9484f13db66b85753d96, models.py is fc5dd4e4f5998e541702d2eaa0dbd452f5a9efd5a2ebe9b7510f676f28719acd, and run.sh is db830918db522c6488f1f2e390b317e8f3fc8b8f25e158ae48ae6342b3d0a11f. CSV SHA-256 values are Reasoning QA b029466444a0c147e189c04ac06c8fe7349bd980fa97bbfcd13cec936a28e412, Llama Questions d5edcfa7581060058e37fb42a3e49ef469550de2b69397f2df750e95c10fb4a4, Web Questions d4d26b7273635c8cbc7ea4462308bb3903bab2b725f8b11080231f1c4202f28f, TriviaQA 7225483a5fe40a477f8d3e93ae74e8b869c24f8f27afd1a6089e6806073d3248, and AlpacaEval 844c49ac6af96421939e054d014f3204dcb0c3b8743fdac037e829b58b217abe. Parsed row counts exactly match 202/300/1,000/1,000/199, and the tree contains exactly 2,701 component audio files. The fixed harness pins evaluator gpt-4o-2024-08-06 at temperature 0.0. Its Reasoning task script SHA-256 52dafc619ffd2911b731077f6c6d6fa2ad49b241fec73cb71e67e37d70f9f6ab uses five evaluation rounds, a 1-to-5 reference rubric, and reports the percentage scoring at least 4. Llama script a6808907136c78c79752334fd073a54850ed76f25ee58760d79589d4854ab996 uses five rounds and Correct/Incorrect percentage. Web script 6628233c20009beaf0b4b056bb088179c07b9edff4a6f12595eb4df03d9b750c and Trivia script f90a234a7078ac2a2eca6d234f769256842cbc0decd61f7234d7332f7cea5b75 use one round and multiply mean binary correctness by 10 rather than 100. Alpaca script 355934192363ad1076017611e1d7c2b3693c23c4c4a4a9be7f41622e06cceedb uses three rounds and a 1-to-10 quality rating. run.sh launches seven tasks because it adds text variants for Reasoning and Llama to the five audio tasks. These fixed-harness scales and repetitions are not stated in the paper and are recorded as implementation drift rather than silently normalized into the paper protocol. The current HF README points model inference to Baichuan-Omni-1.5, a later service than the paper's Baichuan-Audio code; this does not change the pinned benchmark records. Openness remains categorically public because the dataset is downloadable and ungated, but the fixed HF card declares no dataset license and its tree has no LICENSE file. The Apache text and model-weight statement in the Baichuan-Audio Git repository apply to that model repository and must not be generalized to the HF benchmark data. EN labels were checked for Chinese characters, ZH nodes carry Chinese semantics, all source and drift edges are secondary dashed, EN/ZH positioned topology is identical, and formal drawio/arch/svg/png assets were intentionally not regenerated at source stage. Formal publication evidence [site-a12b-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2546×1125 (English) and 2537×1125 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2544×1123 and 2535×1123. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
